source.source_title: Technical Data Sheet Concerning the Commission Delegated Regulations (EU) No 811/2013 and (EU) No 813/2013 — Grant Aerona HPR290i40
source.verification_notes: The model-specific Grant Ecodesign technical data PDF, current Grant product-page row, matching Heat Pump KEYMARK subtype page and certificate, and SEAI Triple E listing were opened and transcribed. The main model identity and declared test data were checked across the manufacturer and KEYMARK sources. SCOP figures and Triple E CoP lack equivalent test-condition labels across sources and have not been normalized.

extraction.note: Archival-first-pass V2 record. Model-specific manufacturer, KEYMARK and SEAI Triple E source sections are preserved in separate Markdown files. No normalized specifications have been added; values with differing definitions or conditions remain separate.

The listing row does not state the test point or standard for CoP.

sections.heading: SEAI Triple E scheme context
sections.source_text: SEAI distinguishes the Triple E register from HARP. Triple E is a searchable register of energy-efficient products associated with the business Accelerated Capital Allowance (ACA) tax incentive; HARP is the product-efficiency database for home-heating appliances. Triple E listing is not evidence of HARP listing or domestic SEAI heat-pump grant approval.

record_notes: Archival-first-pass record; no normalized_specifications have been added. Category-wide field names and unit conventions remain to be established through the V2 collection process.

SEAI Triple E listing HPU117628 identifies the product name as Grant R290 4kW but its short description says “Grant Aerona R290 2kW Heat Pump”; the manufacturer's product page identifies it as 4kW and the product code is HPR290i40. Preserve the discrepancy.
Manufacturer product-page SCOP 35°C is 4.81; KEYMARK lists SCOP 5.08 low-temperature and 3.74 medium-temperature. These are retained separately and not treated as equivalent.
The Triple E row's CoP 4.99 has no test point or test standard displayed; do not infer the conditions from the matching KEYMARK number.
The KEYMARK refrigerant mass is retained exactly as displayed using a decimal comma; no conversion is made in this record.
The Triple E CoP is retained as published without assigning a test point or standard because the listing row does not state those conditions.
The Triple E register is distinct from HARP and is not proof of domestic SEAI grant approval.
